result.one_liner: Ecwid is a cloud-based ecommerce platform for managing products, orders, customers, and storefront settings across online channels.

evidence.quote: Ecwid REST API exposes products, categories, orders, customers, payment and shipping methods, and storefront settings using OAuth 2.0 authentication with public (read-only) or private access tokens.
Use the token in the "Authorization: Bearer secret_token" header format.
Only stores on paid plans can access API. However, Ecwid provides a free upgrade to a paid plan if you work on store customization, want to build an integration, or develop a public application.

About Ecwid REST API: REST API calls... available endpoints include: Store profile, Products, Categories, Product variations, Product types, Orders, Carts, Customers, Customer groups, Discount coupons.

result.notes: API access requires a paid subscription, but Ecwid offers free paid plan upgrades for qualifying development use cases. Buildable with yellow verdict due to paid requirement, though free alternatives exist for qualifying projects.
